title: Viceregal Lima: a capital of balconies and viceroys
goal: Tell the story of colonial Lima and say what was founded or declared, using the ser passive.
grammar: the passive with ser + past participle

items: I can say what was founded, listed or proclaimed with the passive (*fue fundada*, *fueron incluidos*).
I can say what Lima was in colonial times and what remains of it.
I can use the new words for colonial Lima: *virrey*, *virreinato*, *balcón*, *celosía*.
